user.title: Choose vacuum
user.description: Creates a room queue for this vacuum and a dashboard card to control it.

rooms_clean_area.title: Which rooms should the card offer?
rooms_clean_area.description:
{vacuum} knows these rooms: **{rooms}**.

The card offers all of them. Only pick rooms here if it should show fewer rooms or a different order.

data_description.areas: Pick them in the order the card should show them. Leave empty for all. A room is missing? Vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments.

rooms_script.title: Script and rooms
rooms_script.description: This vacuum can't be sent to a single room by Home Assistant directly, so a script does it: it is started once per room with the variables `area_id`, `area_name` and `vacuum_entity_id` and must send the vacuum to that room. Example in the README.

mapping_missing.title: Map the rooms
mapping_missing.description:
{vacuum} can clean single rooms, but doesn't know yet which of its rooms belongs to which Home Assistant area.

1. Map them in Home Assistant: vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments.
2. Choose **Check again** here.

menu_options.use_script: Use a script per room instead

mapping_unnamed.title: Name the rooms first
mapping_unnamed.description:
{vacuum} only reports numbers for its rooms: {segments}. To map them to your Home Assistant areas, they need names first.

1. Name the rooms in the vacuum's own app (Valetudo: web interface → map → edit segments).
2. Map them in Home Assistant: vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments.
3. Choose **Check again** here.

menu_options.use_script: Use a script per room instead

error.unmapped_areas: Not mapped to a segment of the vacuum: {areas}. Map them first (vacuum entity → settings) or remove them here.

abort.already_configured: This vacuum already has a room queue.

create_entry.reload_browser: Done. The dashboard card **Vacuum Room Queue** was added as well – reload this browser page once (or the app) so it shows up, otherwise the dashboard shows a configuration error.

init.title: How the vacuum gets to a room
init.description:
**Directly (recommended):** Home Assistant sends the vacuum straight to the room. Needs a vacuum that supports this and whose segments are mapped to areas.

**With an own script:** for vacuums that can't do this – you write a script that sends the vacuum to one room.

rooms_clean_area.title: Rooms and waiting time
rooms_clean_area.description:
{vacuum} knows these rooms: **{rooms}**.

The card offers all of them. Only pick rooms here if it should show fewer rooms or a different order.

data_description.areas: Pick them in the order the card should show them. Leave empty for all. A room is missing? Vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments.
data_description.start_timeout: How long the vacuum may take to start cleaning after it was sent to a room, before the card reports "did not start". Stations that wash or dry the mops first need a few minutes.
